judgment.confirmed_text: summary, notes and scope_note re-read against the analysis and releases stored in this run and left unchanged; evidence under 'summary' and 'notes'
judgment.status_reasoning: The latest event in the stored files is the Governor's signature on 10 Sep 2026 (Governor's release of that date). No stored file gives the bill's operative date or an urgency clause. Under California's general rule a non-urgency statute takes effect on 1 January after enactment, i.e. 1 Jan 2027; that rule is not in a stored source. Today is 18 Oct 2026, before 1 Jan 2027, so 'Adopted, not yet in force' holds; date_in_force stays null until the chaptered text or a legislature page giving it is stored.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Not AI-specific (it amends the crime of sexual exploitation of a child and the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act) but brings digitally altered and AI-generated child sexual abuse material within mandated reporting; the existing scope_note stays.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the signing date, 10 Sep 2026, from the dated release that announces the signing.
